official_name: Self Employment Scheme for Rehabilitation of Manual Scavengers
objective: Provide cash assistance and skill training for rehabilitation of manual scavengers.
description: One-time cash assistance of Rs 40,000 and free skill training with stipend Rs 3,000/month for identified manual scavengers.
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
source_sections: e-Shram Social Security Welfare Schemes - SRMS
